subject: Request for Privileged SOC 2 Type II — NDA required
messages:
From: Andrew Bishop <andrew.bishop@blueridgecap.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@blueridgecap.com
Date: 2027-05-09T15:22:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 Type II (2026) — request and gating NDA

Hi Jasmine,

We are kicking off our vendor security review for the upcoming board audit and need access to Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report that covers the 2026 audit period. The audit team requires: the full SOC 2 Type II report, the auditor bridge letter if available, and clarification on the audit period (start/end dates and time zone).

Because the report contains privileged details, our security/legal team will need a mutually executed NDA before you can share the report PDF. Can you: 1) confirm the audit period covered by the report, 2) send your standard mutual NDA for countersignature, and 3) indicate the earliest you can provide the report once the NDA is in place?

We typically turn these around in 48–72 hours. Looping in Erica from our external audit team (erica.daley@auditco.com) in case she has follow-ups.

Thanks,
Andrew Bishop
Head of Vendor Risk — BlueRidge Capital
security@blueridgecap.com

--
Note: please send any files as download links or DocuSign envelopes; we cannot accept unsecured attachments.

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Bishop <andrew.bishop@blueridgecap.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T01:08:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II (2026) — request and gating NDA

Andrew — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front:
- Audit period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 UTC.
- We can provide the full Type II report after a mutual NDA is executed; typical turnaround is same-business-day once countersigned.

Attached is our standard mutual NDA (mutual_nnda_redwood_20270511.pdf). Please review and return via DocuSign if acceptable. Marcus (legal ops) and Karthik (security) are on cc to expedite.

If you prefer a bridge letter in lieu of the full PDF initially, we can provide a signed bridge letter from our auditor that confirms the report scope while the NDA route is processed. Which would you prefer?

Next steps suggested:
1) Andrew to confirm preferred path (full report vs bridge letter first)
2) BlueRidge returns countersigned NDA via DocuSign link (I can reissue if you need a different signer)
3) Redwood shares secure link to report / bridge letter within 1 business day after countersign

Attachments: mutual_nnda_redwood_20270511.pdf, soc2-access-checklist_20270511.xlsx (checklist for what your auditors usually request).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Manager, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

Jasmine — thanks. For speed, we prefer the bridge letter first so the audit team can start reviewing scope while our legal team runs the NDA to our signatory. Can you provide the bridge letter and any public summary docs (SOC 2 cover letter, control matrix summary)?

Also: our legal team may propose one minor edit to the mutual NDA around the jurisdiction clause (we ask for Delaware or NY; happy to discuss). We'll return it via DocuSign as soon as legal signs off.

—Andrew
